name: Bombardier Inc.
summary: Bombardier Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of business aircraft and aircraft structural components worldwide. It also provides various services, such as parts, service centers, smart services, training, and technical publications. The company serves multinational corporations, charter and fractional ownership providers, governments, and private individuals. Bombardier Inc. was incorporated in 1902 and is based in Dorval, Canada.
